lines.notes: Sales in accounts 400-418; cost of sales 600-618. Synopsis is on PDF page 209 (Accounts 400-418 New Cars Retail). The manual text does not reproduce the operating-report line-number grid, so line_number is null.
Account 446A (Certified) and 446B (Other) — retail sales. Synopsis page 239.

lines.canonical_name: Variable Selling Expense — Vehicle Salespeople Compensation
lines.notes: Account 011 Vehicle Salespeople — Compensation and Other. Index at page 615 cross-refs 'Variable Selling 362, 365, 368'. Synopsis at PDF page 358.
Account 020 (Personnel Expense). Note: sales-person compensation itself is in Account 011 (Variable Selling) at p358; 020 covers owner/exec manager comp.
Account 076 Interest Floorplan (Semi-Fixed). Index page 615: 'Floorplan Interest 437, 441'. Main synopsis page 433; floorplan credits (Account 078) at page 437.
Account 065 Advertising (Semi-Fixed Expenses). Often offset by manufacturer advertising assistance; see also Factory Receivables 261 for co-op.

lines.canonical_name: Customer Pay Labor — Cars & Light Duty Trucks (Sales)
lines.notes: Account 460A Customer Labor – Cars & Light Duty Trucks (461A for Commercial/Fleet/Medium Duty). Synopsis at PDF page 263.
Account 462 Warranty Claim Labor – Mechanical. Body shop warranty labor is Account 472 at page 315.
Account 463 Internal Labor – Mechanical. Used for labor the service dept performs on dealership-owned vehicles (e.g., reconditioning, delivery prep).
Accounts 467 (Cars & Light Duty) and 468 (Commercial/Fleet/Medium Duty). Synopsis at PDF page 299.
Account 806 Finance Income-New Vehicles. Used-vehicle counterpart is Account 810 (see index pp. 483, 487). Synopsis page 481.
Account 807 Insurance Commission Earned – New Vehicles. Used-vehicle counterpart is Account 809 at page 487.

Glossary (page 564) defines Variable Gross Profit as 'the combined gross profits of the New and Used Vehicle Departments and the Lease and Rental Department.' Replaces the starter's 'total-gross-profit' — the manual text does not define 'Total Gross Profit' as a distinct form line.
Account 399 Profit and Loss (Owner's Equity, Net Worth section). Synopsis at PDF page 208.
Account 080 Rent (Fixed Expenses). Synopsis at PDF page 440.
Account 087 Utilities (Fixed Expenses). Water, electricity, and heat. Synopsis at PDF page 455.

lines.line_number: Line 36 (Operating Report Page 7); transferred to Line 35 Page 1
lines.notes: Account 952 LIFO Adjustment (Deductions from Income). One of the very few lines the manual explicitly maps to the Operating Report grid: 'Total LIFO Reserve, Line 36, Page 7, will be transferred & displayed on Page 1, Line 35' (e.g., page 31). Synopsis at PDF page 539.
Account 205 Contracts in Transit (Assets / Cash and Contracts). Records finance contracts for new and used vehicle sales submitted to financial institutions. Synopsis at PDF page 18.

No standalone 'Holdback' account in this edition. The glossary (page 560) defines Holdback as ~3% of list price, handled as a receivable from the factory (Account 261 Factory Receivables). Synopsis of 261 is at page 81.
Account 910 Document Handling Fee (Additions from Income). Explicitly stated at PDF page 233: 'displayed on page 7, line 69 of the monthly Operating Report.' Synopsis at PDF page 538.
